title_zh: 比亚迪：从电池到电动汽车
title_en: Chinese Companies (6/20): BYD, from Batteries to Electric Cars
note_en: In 把电池技术和汽车制造结合起来 "bring battery technology and carmaking together," 起来 after the verb 结合 "combine" shows separate things being joined into one, much like English "together" or "up." The 把 structure puts the things being combined before the verb, so the sentence reads "take A and B, combine them together."
